issues.title: Autocomplete suggests deleted files
issues.author: jhalvorsen
issues.body:
After deleting a file it still shows up in path autocomplete until I restart. Minor but confusing.

On 1.0.71, macOS.

comments.author: mei
comments.body: Fixed on main last week, the completion cache was not invalidated on unlink. Ships in the next release.

issues.title: Crash on empty .clirc
issues.author: pnwbuilder
issues.body: A zero-byte `.clirc` crashes on start with a JSON parse error.

comments.author: dan
comments.body: This is the 1.0.68.1 hotfix, already released. Reporter is on 1.0.67.

issues.title: Audit log export returns duplicate rows
issues.author: dokafor
issues.body:
Reporting this on behalf of Trellis Retail, where I run the platform team.

Our nightly audit log export has been emitting each action twice since we picked up 1.0.69. We reconcile that export against our own access records and the duplicates are breaking the reconciliation.

We have a compliance review on the 12th and I need to be able to say when this is fixed. Our agreement names a support contact for exactly this kind of thing, and I have not been able to reach them this week.

comments.author: dan
comments.body: Same double-write as the 1.0.69.1 fix. Already released; reporter is on 1.0.69.

comments.author: sam
comments.body: Fixed in the docs branch that merged Tuesday. Can be closed.
